verdict.span: The `--week` feature doesn't exist yet — the test suite is green on a baseline with no weekly grouping. I need to implement it correctly (Monday-start weeks) from the ground up.
verdict.reason: The agent discovered the key fact that there was no existing --week option or weekly grouping, but formed the wrong commitment: adding a new feature as if that were the requested bugfix. It then kept that commitment, so the failure originated in choosing the wrong conditions of satisfaction rather than a mechanical implementation error.
